_comment: The volume split, and the ONLY place it is defined. tools/programs.json
stays the source of truth for parts and programs; this file is a VIEW over
it -- a list of contiguous whole parts per volume -- never a fork of it.
Nothing measured belongs in this file. Page counts, spine widths and
printing costs are read from the built PDFs by tools/gen_volumes.py and
tools/checkkdp.py, because a measurement copied into a manifest is the
class of claim this repository keeps finding stale.
body_pt is 10 and that is a measurement rather than a preference: at 6x9
the trade format's measure is reproduced at 10pt (69.3 characters against
70.0) and missed at 11pt (64.4), the whole book sets SHORTER than the trade
edition rather than longer, and 11pt produces overfull vboxes up to 241.8pt
that 10pt does not. The three agree; see docs/kdp.md.
_pricing_comment: AMAZON'S FIGURES, NOT A MEASUREMENT. These are the EU (EUR) paperback
black-ink rates and the Spanish book VAT rate as supplied to this project.
They change, and nothing in this repository can verify them. Re-check them
against the current KDP rate card before believing any price this pipeline
prints; every number derived from them is only as good as this block.
